body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target gains +1 Fortitude against the next ranged attack targeting it and resists its next 1 unit of forced movement until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: The target also gains +1 Composure against sensory deception until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Strain - Barrier
rider.html: If you accepted Strain, you know the location of the protected creature through ordinary concealment until your next turn, but not through solid barriers.
